definitions.explanation: Money provided by the government, insurance, or other institutions to individuals or organizations, typically as financial support or compensation.

examples.japanese: {給付金|きゅうふきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}した→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧。
examples.english: I applied for the benefit payment.

examples.japanese: {給付金|きゅうふきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{支給|しきゅう}→支給：02835_shikyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: Distribution of the benefit payments has begun.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{低所得世帯|ていしょとくせたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦{当|あ}たり→当たり：01919_atari⟧{十万円|じゅうまんえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{給付金|きゅうふきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支給|しきゅう}→支給：02835_shikyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The government announced it would provide 100,000 yen per person in benefits to low-income households.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{給付|きゅうふ}→給付：13848_kyuufu⟧ (provision/benefit) and {金|きん} (money). Became extremely common in everyday Japanese during and after the COVID-19 pandemic, when the government distributed {特別定額給付金|とくべつていがくきゅうふきん} (special cash payments) to residents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {給付金|きゅうふきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}する→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧: to apply for a benefit payment
- {給付金|きゅうふきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to receive a benefit payment
- {給付金|きゅうふきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{支給|しきゅう}→支給：02835_shikyuu⟧: distribution of benefits
- {給付金|きゅうふきん}⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧: benefit fraud

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{補助金|ほじょきん}→補助金：19222_hojokin⟧: subsidy — typically for businesses or projects
- ⟦{助成金|じょせいきん}→助成金：11343_joseikin⟧: grant — for specific programs or research
- ⟦{手当|てあて}→手当：04881_teate⟧: allowance — regular payments like child or housing allowance
